item.title: Rallying Cry – November 17, 2026
item.description: From Pakistan expanding social support to unmarried women over 45 and Punjab introducing anti-rape legislation with speedy courts, plus Karnataka rolling out drought-resistant crops and a London housing project that looks straight out of the Stone Age—today’s news is full of hope and progress.
